Chapter 894: Chapter 1: First Arrival in the Immortal Realm (Request for Subscription)_2

To take the next step forward, he had to rely on external opportunities.

Therefore, in recent years, he has been frantically exploring the nearby relics, and to ensure his own safety, he dragged Gao Wuyou along.

In Wu Xiangyan’s eyes, Gao Wuyou was merely a pawn, completely disposable when necessary.

“I am not wrong. To become a strong person, one must be cold and ruthless, even towards close kin in the face of opportunity, let alone friends and comrades?”

“Only with such absolute devotion to cultivation, treating it as one’s everything, can one achieve great success!”

Wu Xiangyan’s thoughts stirred, and he immediately became fervent.

This time, in the relics they explored, they actually found an opportunity of the Jade Immortal level.

Jade Immortal.

That is Jade Immortal.

Even in the Xuantian Immortal Domain, a Jade Immortal is a high and mighty figure, a hint of opportunity from them could enable him to leap to Mahayana, or even Golden Immortal.

“Unfortunately, at that time Gao Wuyou was closer to the Jade Immortal opportunity, so he took it first.”

Wu Xiangyan felt helpless, the Jade Immortal opportunity had fallen into Gao Wuyou’s hands; he had to act early, otherwise what if Gao Wuyou ran away with the Jade Immortal opportunity?

“Gao Wuyou must die.”

Wu Xiangyan thought to himself, this was not only because Gao Wuyou had taken the Jade Immortal opportunity, even if he hadn’t, Wu Xiangyan still wouldn’t let Gao Wuyou go.

A Jade Immortal opportunity, how significant is that? Only if he alone knew about it, it was safe.

The more people know, the greater the risk of leakage.

If the matter of the Jade Immortal opportunity got out, it would attract many from the Mahayana Realm, and even Golden Immortals, by then he would not be able to keep the Jade Immortal opportunity.

Therefore.

To play it safe.

Everyone who knew about the Jade Immortal opportunity had to die.

“Once I get the Jade Immortal opportunity, I will go to Cangwu Immortal City for a secluded cultivation. I absolutely will not go out until I’ve entered the Mahayana Realm.” Wu Xiangyan thought to himself, having already devised a series of plans for himself.

…

[Your perceptivity defies the heavens, observing unknown poisons, completely mastering this type of poison…]

Lin Yuan maintained the Art of Blood Escape and merely observed the poison inside his body for a dozen breaths, and he had already completely mastered the Demonic Marrow Poison.

Completely mastering it means fully understanding this poison and also being able to easily detox.

Although Demonic Marrow Poison was terrifying, Lin Yuan’s realm was too high… Level Eleven Perfect, very close to Level Twelve.

The Demonic Marrow Poison of Transcendance Tribulation Stage, in Lin Yuan’s eyes, was not much different from trivial.

In fact, if it wasn’t for the Demonic Marrow Poison being a unique severe poison in the Immortal Realm, which was slightly unfamiliar to Lin Yuan – ordinary Eighth Layer poison would have been instantly comprehended and mastered by him.

“To detox the Demonic Marrow Poison is very simple…”

Lin Yuan ceased his observation and began circulating his Qi and blood.

The detox method for Demonic Marrow Poison, in the eyes of many immortals in the Immortal Realm, can only be forcibly resolved by relying on a higher level of Immortal Path Origin Source.

For instance, Demonic Marrow Poison of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage would require a Golden Immortal level of Immortal Path Origin Source to suppress and erase it.

But after completely mastering and understanding this poison, Lin Yuan could counteract the poison without any risk, starting from the very perimeter.

Under Lin Yuan’s control, countless Qi and blood subtly converged and interwove, blending with the Demonic Marrow Poison rooted deep in his physique and soul.

Gradually, all the Demonic Marrow Poison began to transform, forming a rich vitality force, starting to heal the injuries of Lin Yuan’s physical body.

Demonic Marrow Poison is a severe poison, but also a great tonic if completely transformed and directly absorbed.

“Solved.”

Lin Yuan slightly nodded his head, having understood the Demonic Marrow Poison, a single thought dissolved all accumulated severe poison deep in his body and soul.

One should know, even if there were really a Golden Immortal willing to expend their Origin Source to save someone severely poisoned by Demonic Marrow, it would also require a considerable amount of time, hundreds to thousands of years of recovery might be needed.

Moreover, for a Golden Immortal to spend Origin Source to save someone just at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage? Even close relatives might not choose to do so.

Consuming Origin Source would cause a decline in strength, which is dangerous for any Golden Immortal, highly likely prompting enemies to take advantage and strike.

…

“Hmm?”

“Gao Wuyou stopped?”

From the high altitude behind, Wu Xiangyan slightly startled.

For in his spiritual sense that had locked on, he found that Gao Wuyou, who was fleeing using the Art of Blood Escape, had voluntarily dispersed the Escape Light and halted in place.

“It’s because he’s reached his limit.”

Wu Xiangyan had a clear understanding, within his prediction, Gao Wuyou could only last this long, due to the consumption of the Art of Blood Escape, the severe injuries, and the torment of the demonic marrow poison.

Gao Wuyou being able to endure till now, already counted as having a firm will and profound strength.

“I hope the Jade Immortal opportunity isn’t too badly damaged.”

Thinking inside, Wu Xiangyan also anticipated that Gao Wuyou, before dying, would probably try his best to destroy the Jade Immortal opportunity.

Those items and Immortal Artifacts at the Jade Immortal level, Gao Wuyou definitely couldn’t handle, but the jade slips recording techniques and legacies, maybe not.

But Wu Xiangyan felt, even the most fragile jade slip, being left by the Jade Immortal, should not be so easily destroyed, right?

Especially given Gao Wuyou’s condition, how much strength could he have to destroy them?

Swoosh.

Wu Xiangyan also stopped his motion, gazing towards the distant Gao Wuyou.

“Gao Wuyou? Why aren’t you running anymore?”

Wu Xiangyan carefully observed Gao Wuyou, although convinced that Gao Wuyou was already spent, he still couldn’t be careless.

The Jade Immortal opportunity was right before his eyes, the path to broaden his journey right in front.

Wu Xiangyan certainly did not want to capsize in the gutter.

“Gao Wuyou, do you have any last words now?” Wu Xiangyan looked at Gao Wuyou, an unusual feeling faintly surfacing in his heart.

For some reason, the Gao Wuyou before his eyes felt strange, as if he was no longer the Gao Wuyou he knew.

“Forget it, let’s just take action.”

Wu Xiangyan felt somewhat panicky inside and decided to use his strongest killing move to end Gao Wuyou.

Originally, he had planned to savor the feeling of victory, but now the unfamiliarity of Gao Wuyou made his heart tremble.

“Five Elements Cycle.”

With a thought from Wu Xiangyan, the powers of the Five Elements rules, Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth started to circulate.

Each of the Five Elements was a fundamental rule, but combined, they could approach the Pillar-level rules.

Wu Xiangyan was able to possess the peak strength of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage by relying on his understanding of the Five Elements rules. In fact, Wu Xiangyan vaguely sensed, if he could continue on the path of the Five Elements, he might have a chance to step into the Mahayana Realm.

But it was just a slim chance, and he didn’t know how much time it would cost, so ultimately Wu Xiangyan decided to place his hopes on external opportunities.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan spared a sliver of his spirit, glancing at Wu Xiangyan.

He had been focusing most of his spirit on his physical body, constantly making numerous adjustments to it with his own spiritual will.

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, Gao Wuyou’s physical body was terribly inadequate, many powers were uncoordinated, which wasn’t an issue of the strength or weakness of the physical body but one of perfection.

Even the weakest physical body, an ordinary mundane body, as long as its various powers were united, could be considered perfect.

Of course, the stronger the physical body, the more enormous the powers it contained, and the harder it was to coordinate them all.

“Five Elements rules?”

Lin Yuan remembered Wu Xiangyan, whom his original self regarded as a kin, heaved a sigh, and the spacetime in all directions began to solidify, all rules, including the Five Elements rules, began to shatter.

Dozens of Pillar-level Fusion Rules insights reached the Seventh Realm, as well as the mid-stage Sixth Realm insights into the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

This allowed Lin Yuan, even though he had just arrived and hadn’t fully adjusted his physical body, to have enough self-protection power, or at least if faced with a Jade Immortal’s pursuit, he could easily escape by leveraging his mastery over spacetime.

As for someone at the peak of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage like Wu Xiangyan? No different from an ant.

“What?”

Wu Xiangyan’s pupils suddenly constricted, in his field of vision, the Five Elements rules he had comprehended seemed to have completely vanished, in an instant, not only the Five Elements rules, but all other rule fluctuations also disappeared, as if he had come to a realm completely devoid of rules.

“Run!”

A great fear surged in Wu Xiangyan’s heart, although he did not understand the reason for all this, or its connection to Gao Wuyou, he fled far away without hesitation.
